chat.t: Are you there, Fixer?

o: What's this about?

chat.t: Well, a new product came out today!
I thought I'd give you the first chance to buy it!

o: A new product?

chat.t:
Ta-da! It's a Lucky Charm!
It wards off bad luck and only lets good energy in!
Just for you, Fixer, 50,000 Credits a bundle! What do you say?
Oh, and if you don't need a talisman, I also have Red Ropes!

o: That's way too expensive! It's a total rip-off!!

chat.t: Hehe... It's made with plenty of care and... L-O-V-E, you know!

o: ...It's still too expensive. Can't you give me a little discount?
Wait, rope...? What am I supposed to use that for?

chat.t:
You use it to seal away impure things!
Urges and lust, for example!
Oh, of course, it can seal away the power of Aberrant Spirits, too!

o: I don't need one.
I don't have anything to tie up anyway.

chat.t: Hehehe, and here I was going to throw in a few prototypes with your order!

o: Prototypes?

chat.t: Prototypes I've tested on myself... by sticking them to my body and tying myself up with them!
Oh, on my bare skin, of course! That's how they work best, after all!

o: Where are you? Quick, tell me.
Hey.
Hand over my spank-bank material—I mean, the prototypes—before you go!

chat.t: Heh, don't worry.
I already left them in your room before I headed out, Fixer!

o: When?! How?!

chat.t: I have my ways!
Well then, make sure to call me next time, okay?
If you don't keep your promise... Heh...

o: Okay, I got it!

lines.t: Blossom Garden

...Hmm.
Come to think of it, that Lucky Charm sounds shady in more ways than one.
Well, I'm not buying it to actually use it. I just want the prototypes—

Heh, what a shame!
I was hoping you'd actually use it!
Whoa, you scared the crap out of me!!
How long have you been standing there...?

Hmm... Who knows?
Maybe I was here all along?

Liar.
You definitely weren't here a second ago!
I've been doing this long enough to sense when someone's—

Hehe...
You already know how I get around!
The details are a trade secret, though!

*Sigh*...
Fine, suit yourself.

You're here to do business, right?
Come on, show me what you've got.
There's no need to be in such a rush!

We've still got plenty of time...
And it's such a lovely day, isn't it?

While we're here, we could take a walk together... or just hang out...
What do you say?
...Do you really have that much free time?
Hmm, quite a bit, actually!
I've got plenty of stock, but not many customers who catch my eye!
What's that supposed to mean?
If I don't like a customer, I don't really feel like selling to them!
Other than my regulars and a few customers I'm close to, nobody really catches my interest!

Of course, for events and festivals...
On special occasions, I sometimes sell a bit of everything, like a general store...

So basically, you pick and choose your customers?
Must be nice having that kind of luxury.
Heh, I make the finest talismans and Curse Tools in Quartet. I can afford to be choosy!

People line up to buy from me!
But if I don't feel like selling, why should I?

Man, must be nice.
I don't have that luxury, you know.
I'm just a broke Fixer who can't afford to be picky about jobs.
I've got a commission to stand in line for someone right after this, so hurry up and show me the goods.

Oh my, really?
What a shame!
Then why don't I come along and help with your commission?
That way, I can show you just how effective my Curse Tools really are!

What? Why would you want to help with my job?
Don't waste your precious time waiting in line.

Or are you offering to stand in line for me?
I'll happily take the money!

Heh, standing in line for you doesn't sound very appealing...
But keeping you company in line sounds lovely!
...Huh?

Hehehe...
So, what's your answer?
...Forget it. It'd be a waste of your time.
I'll call you next time I actually need a hand.

Hehehe...
That works too!
...By the way.

You said you're picky about your customers...
So why me?
I don't know the first thing about sorcery or Mystic Arts, so why come to me...?
Oh my, I never said I only sell to experts, did I?
I go by two things: how much someone interests me, and how much they need me!

Hmm...
So, which one am I?

The first, of course!
Though naturally, it's easier to drop by when you need me!

So I'm the kind of customer who doesn't make you any money?
And you're okay with that?

Yes! If you don't have money, I can always collect payment some other way!
Heh...

Besides... call it a merchant's instinct.
I have a feeling you could be my own Lucky Charm, Fixer!

This bond between us is priceless, and fate brought us together...
That's what matters to me!
Bonds and fate, huh? That's getting a little deep for me.
If you need a Lucky Charm, can't you just use the ones you make?

Oh, that wouldn't work!
There's no point using a talisman I made myself!
It goes against the laws of heaven. It would only bring bad luck!

Really?
Well then...

...Then how about giving me your goods for free from now on?
I'll put them to good use.
Pfft, ahahahaha...!

S-Sorry!
That was just too funny...

Well, all right! I suppose that's fate, too.
Money doesn't mean that much to me anyway!
Are you serious?!

Anyway, I was kidding about getting them for free. Just kidding.
Though I wouldn't say no to a gift...

Hmm...
Is that so?

W-What?
Why are you looking at me like that?
...Fixer, what do you need most?

...?
Money, obviously—

Then, money or a beautiful woman?
Which would you choose if you could only have one?

...That's a tough question.
Can't I have both?

Oh my!
Then that means you need me, doesn't it?
You need someone as wealthy and beautiful as me that badly? Oh, you've made me so happy!

...Yeah, yeah.
Must be nice being so rich and pretty, ma'am.
More importantly, how long are you gonna keep playing word games like this?

Hehe...
I just didn't want to say goodbye! I wanted any excuse to spend a little more time with you!

But you're busy, and I shouldn't keep you!
This will have to do for today. I'll head back!
Don't forget to call me next time, okay?

...Fine.
I'll call you next time I'm on a commission or something.

Heh... Great.
Let's do that!
Well then, be sure to call me again!

Phew...
Keeping up with a free spirit like her is exhausting...

Wait.
She left without giving me the goods?!

o: Hey.

chat.t: Yes?

o: Whoa, that was fast.
Don't tell me you've been staring at your messages this whole time?

chat.t: Oh my! How did you know?
Just kidding, just kidding!
So, what's going on?

o: It's about that commission I mentioned last time.
You said you wanted to tag along and show off what your goods can do.

chat.t: Oh my, is that right?
Got it. Send me the location and I'll head right over!

o: Hey, do slots normally pay out this well?
I didn't hit the jackpot, but I kept winning. I think I just made a month's worth of commission pay in no time.

chat.t: Heh, that's my Lucky Charm for you!
I slipped it into your pocket when you weren't looking, Fixer! It seems to have worked like a charm!

o: Wait, you can't just do that without telling me!

chat.t: Well, we were there to test your luck, too!
You're not going to say something stuffy like "Isn't that cheating at a casino?" are you?

o: As if. Actually, I love it.
Anyway, making bank is great and all, but all these winnings basically came out of your pocket.
Are you seriously letting me keep all of it?

chat.t: Oh my, what do you mean, my money?
You're the one who played the slots, Fixer... so you earned that money, didn't you?

o: Hey, I'm not shameless enough to just pocket this much money for nothing.
At least let me buy you a gift or a meal or something.

chat.t: Hmm... There are things I want, of course. I'll give it some thought! Heh.
Still, I never thought I'd hear you claim to have any shame, Fixer...

o: Why you little...

chat.t: Just kidding, just kidding!

lines.t: Humanitas Street
...*Sigh*. Now what do I do?
Guess I'll send her a MochiTalk and tell her she doesn't need to come...
I'm here!
Oh my, why the long face?
Well, I asked you to come along on a commission, but it just got canceled.

So I was about to message you, but...
You got here way faster than I expected.
...Seriously, can't you teach me that Mystic Art of yours?

Hehe, I'm afraid that's a trade secret!
Besides, not just anyone can use it!
What sort of commission was it, anyway?

...I was supposed to find a runaway cat.
The luckier you are, the sooner you find it.
Except apparently, the cat walked back home on its own this morning.

I'll still get a small fee for the same-day cancellation, but...
This wasn't exactly what I had in mind...
Oh my, how lucky for the client!
What a relief that the cat made it back home safe and sound!
Well, sure, but that means we lost our chance to test out your goods, right?
So now we're both free, and this was all a waste of time...

Heh, that's hardly a problem!
There's more than one way to test them!

Besides, your plans were canceled, and you still got paid...
That sounds like a win to me!
Unless you're the hardworking type who actually enjoys work, Fixer?

Like hell I am!!
I'm just a regular guy who'd rather slack off whenever he can!
If I were loaded, I wouldn't even be working this hard.
Heh, then it really did work out for the best!
Now we can spend the rest of the day doing something much more worthwhile, can't we?

You sure are an optimist.
I made you come all this way, and you're not even mad that I wasted your time.

Phew...
Yeah, to be honest, the pay for this job wasn't much anyway...
Getting to enjoy yourself while you can is a blessing!
So, why don't we go have some fun, like I suggested last time?
It's another lovely day, after all!
...I've been meaning to ask: why do you want to spend time with me so badly?

Oh my, don't you want to?
I'd be a little hurt...
No, that's not what I meant!
How did you get that from what I said?!
*Sob, sob*...

*Sigh*...
Forget it, just forget it.
I can tell you're fake-crying, so drop the act.

Oh my.
You caught me!
...If you were actually trying to fool me, you'd at least put some effort into it.
You're just looking for an excuse to mess with me, aren't you?!
Heh, I suppose so!
But your reactions are so entertaining, Fixer! How could I possibly resist?

I really do like you!
You're never boring!

And thanks to you, I'm completely drained.
*Sigh*...

I have no idea what you see in me, but anyway...
What do you want to do? Just so you know, I'm broke.

Heh, leave that to me!
I'm rich and pretty, remember? I'll take care of everything!
You've been going on about being rich and pretty since last time. You're not shy, are you?
I doubt there are many people who could say that about themselves with a straight face.
Heh, that's just me, Fixer! You'll have to get used to it!
So, shall we go have some fun?
...Fine, let's go.
Is there anywhere you want to go?

Hmm...
How about we go to our casino?
I hear there's a Bunny Girl Casino, and I've been meaning to check it out!
I'll cover the cost, so don't worry!
...And off she goes again.
Why do I feel like she's leading me around by the nose every time we meet...?
Hurry up and come along!
I'm coming, I'm coming!

o: Hey, I've got something to ask you.

chat.t: Hmm? What is it, Fixer?

o: You said you'd let me get you a gift last time, remember?
Just wondering if you've given it any thought.

chat.t: I've thought about it plenty! Nothing has really clicked yet, though.
What brought this on?

o: No reason. Just thought you might've forgotten.
Better decide before it slips your mind.

chat.t: Hmm... Actually, there is something you could help me with.

o: What is it?

chat.t: I've got a prototype I'd like to test... and I could use an assistant!
I'd be testing Sealing Implements and Curse Tools other than the Lucky Charm on my own body, though...

o: An experiment? On your body?
I'm on my way. Sit tight.

chat.t: Oh my, Fixer! When did you leave?
And here I was going to at least make you breakfast!
Grilled eel over rice, with all sorts of drinks to help you get your stamina back...

o: Because I thought you'd drain me dry if I stayed any longer, that's why!
...Wait, how did I end up in Humanitas? I was definitely in Quartet...

chat.t: Oh, I put a Return Talisman on your clothes just in case, Fixer!
I couldn't have you getting lost if you left on your own, could I?

o: ...Don't tell me this is some kind of portal?!

chat.t: Who knows! If I told you, I'd have even more reason to keep you here, Fixer. For security, of course!

o: Like you had any intention of letting me go in the first place!!

chat.t: Hehe... Playing hard to get is part of your charm, Fixer!

lines.t: Blossom Garden
She definitely said to just wait right here...

Oh my, Fixer! You're early!
I thought you'd take longer!
Were you that eager to start the experiment?
...I'm not even surprised anymore.
Weren't you the one who got here early to wait for me?
Hehehe, figuring out when you'll arrive is child's play for me, Fixer!
More importantly, it's been a while since I've had a guest over!
Wait, we're doing the experiment at your house?
One of my villas, to be precise!

Demonstrating a proven product is one thing,
but I'm not testing a prototype out here!

Must be nice being rich.
How many houses do you own, anyway?

If you've got that many, buy the building our hideout's in, too.
Then we wouldn't have to pay rent.

Heh, I actually looked into buying that building once!
It's just never been on the market.

If the owner doesn't want to sell,
it doesn't matter how many buyers are lining up!
...Lining up?
Hehe, let's just say quite a few people have their eye on that land!
Now then, shall we get going?
Sure. Wait, which way—
Whoa, what are you doing?!
What do you mean? I'm only holding on to you, Fixer!
No, I mean, I like it, but we're supposed to be going to your house, so why—
My house... well, all my houses, actually... are protected by various formations and Mystic Arts!

Unless you know a great deal about Mystic Arts...
You could damage your mind trying to get in, or lose your way and wander forever...
Well, you wouldn't die! You'd just go missing for a while and turn up stranded somewhere, half-starved!
What kind of security system is that?! That's even scarier!!
Which means the security is flawless!
Which is why I have to be extra careful when bringing guests over!
I have a bad feeling about this...
Now then, shall we head over?
Whoa??!
Ugh, my head...
Why does coming to your house give me such a splitting headache...?

Ah, dammit... What is this?
Why is it so dark?

I have no idea where I am.
I was just with Yomi a second ago...
I stretched out my hands and felt around as I took a few steps forward.
A few steps later, my hands found something soft and squishy.
Heh...
...Huh? Why am I getting major déjà vu—
Yomi's Room
Oh my, I only stepped back for a moment in case you felt dizzy...
You're certainly eager to experiment! I love it!
Here, Fixer! Could you hold the end of this red thread for me?
There are a few things we need to do before we can start!
Uh... yeah. Sure, why not.
Now then, could you try channeling your energy into it?
Just like that?
It's an experiment, after all!
This is nothing like what I had in mind...
Screw it. Hup...!
Ngh... The rope... against my body...
Hehe, don't stop—keep going!
Screw it. Hup...!
Nngh... Ngh?! Th-This is—
Haaah!!!
Yomi's Room
What started as a test fitting gradually turned into something else entirely...

I spent the whole night fending off Yomi's advances until I had no energy left.
When I realized I couldn't take any more, I practically fled, but...
Humanitas Back Alley
Huh...?

I was just inside her house. How did I open the door and end up...
right in the back alley outside my place?
*Sigh*... Seriously, ever since I got mixed up with her, it's been one bizarre thing after another...

o: ...So what was all that about last time?

chat.t: Hehehe... It means I belong to you now, Fixer! ♡

o: Since when do you belong to me?!
Normally, I'd say "Even better!" But you're really throwing me for a loop here.

chat.t: Hehe, ropes can hold you in place, or bring things together.
They're the perfect curse tool for seals and contracts!

o: ...Contract? What contract?

chat.t: That makes yesterday's experiment a huge success!
Of course, your energy was so powerful and wild, Fixer...
that now my body can't live without you!

o: What's that supposed to mean? You can't just say things like that!
The more you say, the scarier this gets. Stop beating around the bush.
Hey
Why aren't you answering—
I can't take any more
Seriously. I've got absolutely nothing left

chat.t: Hehe, thank you for your hard work!
Oh well... If the urges come back tonight...
I'll just have to take care of myself somehow! ♡

o: I'm starting to think we've got this owner-and-possession thing backward.
I feel like I've become your personal charging station.

chat.t: Oh, come on now!

o: If I say so, that's how it is.
Just hurry up and figure out how to fix this.

chat.t: Hehe... Spoken like a true "Master"!
That's exactly the attitude I like!

o: Shut up. Stop assigning us roles and getting off on it.

chat.t: Ahaha!

o: Oh, come on.
At this rate, I'm literally going to waste away and die.

lines.t: M.A.D. Hideout

Ugh, you scared me!!
Can't anyone in this world leave a door alone?!

Hehe... Hehehe...
I-I can't hold back anymore...
If I don't get some energy from you right this instant, Fixer...
What kind of experiment leaves you like this?!
At least explain what's going on first, come on!!!
And after another storm had passed...
Phew... Thanks for the meal!
This is seriously going to kill me...
How much of my energy do you need before you're satisfied...?

Oh my.
Didn't it feel good for you too?

Sure, it felt good,
but there's a limit to how many times you can drain me in a row...
Besides, it hasn't even been that long since last time...
I can't help it!

I didn't explain this beforehand,
but we're testing a sealing implement designed to seal away urges!
It's meant to help people affected by Corrupting Power live normal lives!
Then why is your sealing implement doing the exact opposite?!

Hehe...
That's your fault, Fixer!
My fault?!

Your energy was so overwhelmingly strong and wild, Fixer...
It shattered every control formula I'd set up!

All that power went straight into my body...
So instead of sealing my urges away, it sent them into overdrive!

Well, that's news to me...
Is there something wrong with my energy?

No...
Quite the opposite. I think it's because your energy is pure "urge"!

Of course, people like me, who study curses and formulas and sell them for a living...
are more resistant to that sort of energy, but...

If even I ended up like this...
Hehehe...
An ordinary person would be hooked for good after just one taste of that energy! ♡
...Okay, let's say I buy that.
Why does the seal have to be a tortoiseshell tie, though?

...Hehe.
You need the right balance of carrot and stick to keep your urges in check... and enjoy them to the fullest!
That doesn't answer my question at all...
*Sigh*. Anyway, how do we fix this?

Well, you're my "Master" now, Fixer...
If you want anything, just give the o-r-d-e-r!
Though if my urges flare up, I can't promise I'll do as I'm told! ♡
No, I'm asking how I became your master in the first place...
Was your deepest, darkest urge to become "someone's possession"?
...Hehehe! ♡
...*Sigh*. Forget I asked.
I'm not really in a position to judge someone else's kinks anyway.

There's that, too,
but there's something I've believed for a long time!

That someday, I'd meet my destined partner...
Someone who would treasure me and put my creations to good use...

That's why the "Red Thread of Fate"...
and the two sides of my outfit it connects are under a special curse!
It's designed so that only the person who'll make me "happy" forever can undo it...
...Are you sure it didn't just break the same way that sealing implement did?
If the energy meant for the sealing implement passed through my body and reached my clothes... yes, I suppose that's possible!
But wouldn't you call that "fate," too?
...*Sigh*.

Either way, I can't keep this up. I'm going to waste away and die.
Find a way to fix it. Now.

Hehehe...
It'll take a little time, but I can fix it...

Before that, though...
I think my urges are starting to flare up again...

*Siiigh*...
Guess I have no choice.

chat.t: Fixer... Please come over. Hurry...

o: What do you mean by that?
Come where?

chat.t: The Return Talisman I put on you last time... Take it out and use it again...
Back to... my villa...

o: I don't mind coming over,
but what on earth is going on?

chat.t: Hehe... I just need a little help...
I've been trying to keep my urges in check, but... it's too hard...

o: ...You mentioned your urges, so I'm guessing you'll drain me dry again if I go.

chat.t: I don't think I can hold out much longer...

o: What is that supposed to mean?
Hey
Hey, why aren't you answering?

chat.t: Thanks for the meal!

o: Help... I seriously can't take any more...

chat.t: Hehe, you seem quite satisfied too, Fixer!

o: You're the one who's satisfied, dammit.
I seriously feel like I'm about to pass out.

chat.t: Hehehe, we've got plenty more fun ahead of us. You can't pass out on me already!
So then, what kind of training should I try next?

o: ...Help! There's a demon here who's even worse than a succubus!!!

lines.t: Yomi's Room
What's Yomi up to this time...?
Hey!! I'm here! Where are you?!
No answer... Did something really go wrong?
Maybe I should take a look around the villa—
Haaah...
...? What was that sound...?
After having my way with Yomi to my heart's content...
Yomi's Room
Man, you really tied yourself up tight.
Still, it's always wild how it comes undone the moment I channel energy into it...
Hehe... That's my Fixer!

Aah, I'm still sore all over!
Especially my face... well, my mouth, really...

You certainly had your way with me...
while I was tied up from head to toe and couldn't move an inch! ♡
Ugh...
My "Master" sure has... strong urges!
What do you say, Fixer? Would you like to try wearing... a sealing implement yourself?
Pass. I can control myself just fine.

Anyway, how long were you tied up like that?
I doubt you could use MochiTalk like that...
Oh my, who knows?

Oh, I can get out of the ropes myself!
And I could easily have had my familiars send the messages!
Then what kind of mental training is that supposed to be?
Hehe, holding back your urges as long as you can before letting them loose is a kind of training, too!
More importantly, the energy you just gave me let me get the tuning just right!
The Urge Sealing Implement is finished! It's ready to go on sale!

Right, congrats.
Just so we're clear, I have no intention of wearing one.
Tying someone else up is one thing, but I'm not getting tied up myself.
Oh my, I like tying people up and being tied up!

In that case,
isn't it my turn now?
...Huh?
Oh my, didn't I tell you?
Holding back your urges as long as you can before letting them loose is a kind of training, too...

I don't know about you, Fixer...
but I still... haven't had enough.
And tonight...

Until I'm satisfied...
take care of me, won't you? ♡
Uuuugh, aaah...
Aaaargh!!!
